summary: Verified iter104 changes end-to-end. Backend 6/6 pytest pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter104_strava_and_health_rename.py): GET /api/connections (demo@roujaune.app/demo9900) returns providers including id='apple_health', id='health_connect' (name EXACTLY 'Google Health (Health Connect)', kind=device_native, requires_native_build=true, connection_status=requires_build), and id='strava' (name='Strava', kind=cloud_oauth, configured=false, connection_status=not_configured, connected=false). No provider with id='google_fit' is present. POST /api/connections/strava/authorize with {"redirect_uri":"roujaune://oauth/strava"} returns 200 {"setup_required": true} (no authorize_url leak). Frontend /connections @ 1280x900 landscape after email login: OUTDOOR RIDE SYNC section renders the Strava provider card (testID=provider-strava) with a 'Setup required' chip, a 'Set up' primary button (testID=connect-strava), and 'Requires Strava credentials' helper text. HEALTH SYNC blurb reads 'Sync your rides with Apple Health (iOS) and Google Health (Health Connect, Android — covers Samsung Health & Google Fit).' — contains the required 'Google Health (Health Connect' substring. Regressions clean: BLE demo works (device-btn-trainer opens ble-panel portal, ble-scan surfaces demo devices — Demo Smart Trainer + Demo Heart Rate visible in scan list within 2.5s), and IMPORTED OUTDOOR RIDES card renders both seeded rides (count=2, Col de Test entries). Tapping connect-strava did not surface a window.dialog because Alert.alert on RN-web is a portal Modal (per agent-to-agent note); we did not further probe it since the backend contract already covers setup_required and the button visibly says 'Set up'.

frontend/app/connections.tsx:104-108 correctly toggles the primary button label between 'Connect' (configured) and 'Set up' (not_configured) driven by p.configured — no client-side branching bug.
HealthSyncCard.tsx web-preview branch (line 25) already mentions 'Google Health (Health Connect, Android — covers Samsung Health & Google Fit)' — no drift with the Android on-device blurb.
